entity.summary: Non-custodial multichain wallet ecosystem from Ava Labs covering Avalanche, EVM networks and Bitcoin across extension, mobile and web surfaces.
entity.notes: Current first-party Core documentation explicitly describes Core as non-custodial and separates web, browser-extension and mobile surfaces. Avalanche ecosystem history is not reused as a wallet launch date.

products.summary: Core non-custodial browser extension for Avalanche and supported networks.
products.notes: Selected extension runtime only; Core mobile and web are distinct surfaces and deferred. Current first-party support says the extension is officially supported on Chrome.

evidence.title: Core Documentation — Introduction
evidence.notes: Current first-party Core documentation describes Core as a non-custodial crypto wallet and lists web, extension, iOS and Android surfaces.

evidence.title: What is the Core extension?
evidence.notes: Current first-party support identifies Core extension as a free non-custodial browser extension and states current official Chrome support.
